name: Paris Meeting Archive
summary: Searchable archive of City of Paris, Kentucky government meetings — official agendas, minutes, AI summaries, and structured facts. All public surfaces are CORS-open with no auth or signup.

content_provenance.sources: Public primary sources only: the jurisdiction's official agenda and minutes documents, published through its CivicClerk portal.

ai_disclosure.meeting_records: Document-driven: GPT-4o extracts structured facts and Anthropic Claude Sonnet writes the narrative summary from the official minutes/agenda. No verbatim transcript.

verification.meetings: Each answer cites a clip_id; open https://paris.civicmemory.news/meeting/{clip_id} for the official agenda & minutes (and meeting-video link where available).
verification.guidance: We are a secondary source. For legal or official use, cite the underlying primary source we link, not us.

sites.role: City of Paris, Kentucky meeting archive + RAG

license: Built from public primary sources. Attribution to Paris Meeting Archive is appreciated; verify against the linked originals for high-stakes use.
